secretPolicy: This inventory records capability and boundary metadata only. It never stores credential values, tokens, cookies, or private command arguments.

automations.name: CI
automations.purpose: Install frozen dependencies, type-check, test, and production-build the application.

automations.name: CI Health Monitor
automations.trigger: every six hours and manual dispatch
automations.purpose: Boundedly re-run failed workflows for the current commit only.

automations.name: Daily Maintenance
automations.trigger: daily at 03:15 UTC and manual dispatch
automations.classification: working locally and in hosted GitHub Actions
automations.purpose: Run the reusable inventory, format, type, test, build, migration, audit, and diff checks and upload non-secret execution artifacts retained for 100 days.

automations.name: Hourly website continuation
automations.trigger: planned hourly UTC callback, capped at 2,400 cycles
automations.purpose: Verify cron authentication and database availability, then persist an idempotent non-secret cycle record without accessing external connectors.
automations.evidence: The project-owned Heartbeat is enabled at 0 0 * * * * UTC. Eight authorized callbacks have returned HTTP 200. The eighth cycle also recorded database-probe, schedule-ownership, GitHub-workflow-passed, and cycle-limit validation results.

automations.name: Daily GitHub and Drive summary
automations.purpose: Summarize accessible GitHub and Google Drive activity without external mutation.

cliReadiness.name: git and GitHub CLI
cliReadiness.boundary: Authenticated repository access and GitHub Actions inspection are available.

cliReadiness.name: Google Workspace CLI
cliReadiness.boundary: Read-only Drive metadata retrieval is available.

cliReadiness.name: Gemini CLI
cliReadiness.boundary: CLI 0.55.1 is installed and its supported trusted-workspace connectivity check returns API_KEY_INVALID; provider-managed credential renewal is required.

cliReadiness.name: Antigravity CLI
cliReadiness.boundary: No Antigravity executable or connector configuration is available in the current session; previous provider sign-in requirements remain unbypassed.

cliReadiness.name: Datadog CLI
cliReadiness.boundary: No project integration or installed CLI was discovered.

terminalHistory.reuseRecommendation: Do not replay commands automatically; continue to promote only freshly validated procedures into version-controlled scripts.

gitRecovery.reuseRecommendation: Preserve through normal Git retention; do not reset or replay without a concrete recovery need.
Preserve as Git recovery metadata; equivalent validated remediation is already represented in current history.

historicalAudit.synchronizationBoundary: The managed WebDev repository and matching GitHub repository have distinct histories; synchronize validated files deliberately rather than rebasing unrelated roots.
